+++ b/lib/crewai-tools/tests/tools/test_tool_usage.py
@@ -0,0 +1,37 @@
+import pytest
+
+from crewai.tools.tool_usage import ToolUsage
+
+class DummyI18N:
+    def __init__(self, message):
+        self.message = message
+    def __getattr__(self, item):
+        if item == "tool_usage_exception":
+            return self.message
+        raise AttributeError(f"Unknown attribute {item}")
+
+class DummyAgent:
+    def __init__(self, i18n):
+        self.i18n = i18n
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("custom_message", [
+    "Custom error message from prompt file.",
+    "Another custom tool usage message."
+])
+def test_toolusage_uses_agent_i18n(custom_message):
+    # Setup agent with custom i18n
+    dummy_i18n = DummyI18N(custom_message)
+    agent = DummyAgent(dummy_i18n)
+
+    # Create ToolUsage with agent
+    tool_usage = ToolUsage(agent, action=None)
+
+    # The _i18n attribute should be the same as agent.i18n
+    assert tool_usage._i18n is agent.i18n
+
+    # The tool_usage_exception message should match the custom message
+    assert tool_usage._i18n.tool_usage_exception == custom_message
+
+    # If ToolUsage used default I18N(), this would fail
+    # So this test fails on buggy code and passes on fixed code
+
task_info.problem_statement: [BUG] ToolUsage not using same I18N as Agent ### Description The ToolUsage class defaults to using I18N() and has no way to update it. It should use the same I18N as the agent so that custom prompt_file's work properly. ### Steps to Reproduce 1. Make a new prompt file (like translation/en.json) and edit the `tool_usage_exception` message. 2. Set your crew to use this new prompt_file. 2. Have an agent use a tool incorrectly. 3. Observe that the error message sent to the AI does not contain the update from 1. ### Expected behavior The tool error message sent to the AI contains the updated wording from the prompt_file ### Screenshots/Code snippets I18N does not use a custom prompt_file. When ToolUsage is created, there is no way to set the prompt_file. ### Operating System macOS Sonoma ### Python Version 3.10 ### crewAI Version 0.70.1 ### crewAI Tools Version 0.12.1 ### Virtual Environment Conda ### Evidence Screenshots above show that the I18N never uses the prompt_file property set on the crew in ToolUsage and has no way of being set. ### Possible Solution When the ToolUsage is created, have it set its i18n to the same as the agent. I will open a PR for this. ### Additional context N/A
